name: TriageCN - Switch Organizational Profiles and Recalculate Triage Queue
description: Verify that selecting different organizational profiles (e.g., Global Retail Bank vs Agile Cloud Tech Startup vs Zero-Match) updates asset importance and recalculates queue rankings.

planSteps.description: Select the profile dropdown or organization selector and switch from Global Retail Bank to Agile Cloud Tech Startup
Verify the active profile indicator updates to Agile Cloud Tech Startup and the remediation queue scores update accordingly
Select the profile selector again and switch to Synthetic Zero-Match (ORG-005)
Verify the view displays 'Nothing matched this profile in the supplied data' rather than fabricating artificial rankings
